consequence.statement: A new optional debugging flag is available in the CLI. Nothing changes for existing setups, so operators don't need to do anything.

original.statement: The flux CLI adds a new `--show-history` flag to the `debug helmrelease` and `debug kustomization` commands.

decision.reason: [ev-e33b9db532e6] and [ev-63a2c708aad5] only say a new `--show-history` flag was added to the `flux debug helmrelease` and `flux debug kustomization` CLI commands. Neither says anything existing is removed, renamed, changed or broken. An operator who does nothing is not affected, so the kind "none" (informational) fits. Grouping two commands into one cluster is a subject issue, not one of the [VERIFY] aspects, and both additions have the same "none" consequence.
